'''Moose''' (Japanese: '''ムース''' ''Moose'') is one of the characters from ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. He is the husband of {{OBP|Layla|M11}}.

==In the movies==
Moose was accompanying his wife to deliver a bouquet of [[Gracidea]]s to his wife's great-grandmother for her hundredth birthday. On a train they met up with {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}}, {{an|Dawn}}, {{OBP|Shaymin|M11}}, [[Sylvan]], [[Shun]], [[Taka]], and {{OBP|Kako|M11}}. He told them that he used to hike a lot and witnessed {{p|Shaymin}}'s flower bearing once before. Shortly after, he watched Shaymin transform into its [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Shaymin|Sky Forme]]. Following this, the train was attacked by [[Zero]]'s {{p|Magnemite}}, {{p|Magneton}} and {{p|Magnezone}}, but Ash, Dawn, and Shaymin were able to drive them off.

He later said his goodbyes to Ash, his friends, and Shaymin as they set off on a ferry to the flower garden of {{si|Gracidea}}, but met up with them again some time later, when Ash and his friends visited Layla's great-grandmother's birthday party.
